support_local_sub: Every booking contributes to conservation efforts.
chat_welcome: Ayubowan! I'm Ceylo, your spirit guide through the island. Where shall we begin your journey?
chat_fallback: Tell me a little more about your trip.
chat_error: I'm having a bit of trouble connecting to my signals. Please check your internet connection.
voice_body: Tap the microphone on your keyboard to dictate your message.
itinerary_offline_body: The recommendation server could not be reached, so your itinerary was built from the on-device destination dataset.
itinerary_body: Your itinerary was built from {{n}} AI-ranked eco-cultural destinations.
prefs_eco_help: Higher favours wildlife, rainforest and low-impact places.
prefs_culture_help: Higher favours temples, ruins and historic towns.
fewer_crowds_help: Prefer places our crowd forecast expects to be quiet.
prefs_saved_body: Your recommendations, trip planner and chatbot will use these.
no_visits: You haven't visited any destinations yet.
consent_intro: CEYLO is part of a university research project on sustainable tourism. With your permission we record how the app is used to measure whether it helps travellers and local communities.
consent_point_events: We record actions such as recommendations shown, places opened or saved, and bookings made.
consent_point_anonymous: Your name, email and phone number are never stored with this data. Results are reported only as totals.
consent_point_location: Your live location is not tracked. It is only used on the phone for nearby places, alerts and check-ins.
consent_point_optout: You can change your mind at any time in Profile. The app works the same either way.
eco_awareness_q: When choosing places to visit, how often do you think about their environmental impact?
survey_intro: About 3 minutes. Answer from your own experience with CEYLO. The usability questions use the standard System Usability Scale and are shown in English.
survey_score: Your usability score is {{score}} out of 100.
fb_relevance_q: Did the stops match what you were looking for?
fb_thanks: Thanks, your rating helps improve recommendations.
